links.outcome: Stability of ChatGPT answers and accuracy on repeated queries of previously incorrect surgical questions
links.effect: Selected answer varied for 36.4% of questions answered incorrectly on first query; response accuracy changed for 6/16 (37.5%) questions.
links.quote: Upon repeat query, the answer selected by ChatGPT varied for 36.4% of questions answered incorrectly on the first query; the response accuracy changed for 6/16 (37.5%) questions.

screen.reason: Evaluates GPT-4 on surgical knowledge question banks and repeat-query stability without testing an organizational deployment practice or safeguard.
